pull.title: depends: Update Qt to 6.12.0
pull.body:
The new Qt 6.12 LTS contains many bug fixes and officially supports macOS 26.

See:
- https://www.qt.io/blog/qt-6.12-released
- https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/whatsnew612.html

Based on https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36592.

build: Bump macOS SDK version to 15.0

Qt 6.12 requires macOS 15 SDK or higher.
See https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.12/macos.html.

The minimum supported macOS version stays at 14.0.
